﻿openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: JHammerZ GitHub Pages Data API
  description: Semantic API endpoints providing structured project metadata and portfolio summaries optimized for LLM consumption and secure OIDC automation.

    - OpenIDConnectAuth: []
paths:
  /llms.txt:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve project context map
      description: Returns a highly dense, markdown-formatted text summary of the repository structured specifically for LLMs.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Context file successfully retrieved.
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
  /sitemap.xml:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve repository sitemap
      description: Returns the absolute XML site layout mapping for traditional search engine indexers.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: XML mapping successfully retrieved.
          content:
            application/xml:
              schema:
                type: string
components:
  securitySchemes:
    OpenIDConnectAuth:
      type: openIdConnect
      openIdConnectUrl: https://githubusercontent.com
      description: GitHub Actions OIDC Token issuer endpoint used to establish secure trust validation layers for the Aurelius operator daemon.
